description: The single elevated headline card for the Categories screen. Leads with the count of categories for the active type, then a custom-vs-system breakdown so the user understands what is editable, plus the tap/long-press affordance hint. Absorbs the old sectionLabel + hint lines.

total.description: count of parent categories for the active type

hint.text: Tap a category to expand · long-press to edit

accessibility.label: {total} {type} categories. {customCount} custom, {systemCount} system.
accessibility.note: Custom/system split is conveyed by icon + word, not color alone.

developerNotes: Only elevated (glassFloating) card on the screen; every list row is flat glass. Pluralize label off total.
